name: ZJ Live Chat
author: Zaman Javed

sections.description:
ZJ Live Chat is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that adds a floating chat button to your website. It allows your visitors to contact you directly through WhatsApp with just one click, providing a seamless support experience.

Key Features

  • Premium Floating Chat Button – Beautiful, modern floating chat button with smooth animations.
  • Customizable Position – Choose to display the button on the left or right side of the screen.
  • Custom WhatsApp Number – Enter your own WhatsApp number with country code.
  • Default Message – Set a pre-filled message that will be sent when users click the button.
  • Tooltip Support – Add custom tooltip text that appears on hover (desktop only).
  • Smooth Entrance Animation – Elegant slide-in animation when the page loads.
  • Premium Glow Effects – Multi-layer shadow with subtle glow animation for better visibility.
  • Hover Effects – Smooth scale and lift effect on hover with enhanced shadows.
  • Device Visibility – Show or hide the button on mobile and desktop devices separately.
  • Custom Chat Button Color – Use the built-in color picker to match your brand identity.
  • Button Size Options – Select from small, medium, or large button sizes.
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized CSS and JavaScript with zero external dependencies.
  • Easy to Use – Simple admin panel with a real-time live preview.
  • Accessibility Ready – Includes ARIA labels, keyboard navigation support, and respects “prefers-reduced-motion” settings.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ZJ Live Chat”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to Settings > ZJ Live Chat to configure your WhatsApp number and style settings.
sections.faq:
What format should I use for the WhatsApp number?

Enter your number with the country code, but without the “+” sign, brackets, or spaces. For example: 1234567890.

Can I hide the button on desktop?

Yes. In the settings page, simply uncheck the “Show on Desktop” option.

Does this plugin track user data?

No. ZJ Live Chat is privacy-friendly. It does not collect any user data or store cookies. It simply acts as a bridge to the WhatsApp application.
